name: @nventr.ai/nventr-agent
description: Core javascript for including nventr-agent in a web application.

scripts.build: npm run build:browser && npm run build:module && npm run build:esm
scripts.dev: cp src/nventr-agent.js dist/nventr-agent.js && nodemon --watch src/nventr-agent.js --exec 'cp src/nventr-agent.js dist/nventr-agent.js'
scripts.build:esm: uglifyjs src/nventr-agent.js --compress --mangle --warn --output dist/nventr-agent.esm.mjs && printf '\nexport default window.nventrAgent;' >> dist/nventr-agent.esm.mjs

author: Steven Swallow
